scope: Native object-visit host and persistence controls on actual Cave vampires; no original quest, scenario victory or campaign completion claimed.

nativeChecks.standardMonsterMessage: The legions of vicious bloodsuckers snarl and hiss at you, baring their sharp white fangs and blood-stained lips. Their leader wears a distinctive red and black cowl and bellows, "We shall destroy you and take over this land! Our master, Zarachodar will RULE!"

limitations: Only the dormant Cave program is admitted by the host.
OB on local-event objects still needs coordination with LE.
OB:H, OB:C, type/subtype mutations and the two-selector receiver forms remain unimplemented.
OB:D/E masks are covered by pure production-function tests for all eight colors; the native map control exercises S/R.
Original full quests, original win conditions and ERM campaign carryover remain unvalidated.
